record.paper_title: Some open problems in mutual stationarity involving inner model theory: a commentary.
record.context_brief: Mutual stationarity on the sequence of ω_n at cofinality ω_1
record.original_question: Let ⟨κ_α | α < δ⟩ be an increasing sequence of uncountable regular cardinals, let κ = sup_α κ_α, and fix a regular cardinal λ < κ_0. For each α < δ, let S_α be a stationary subset of κ_α ∩ {ξ ∈ Ord : cf(ξ) = λ}. Call the sequence ⟨S_α | α < δ⟩ mutually stationary when the set {X ∈ [κ]^λ | sup(X ∩ κ_α) ∈ S_α} is stationary, and write MS(⟨κ_α⟩_{α<δ}, λ) for the assertion that every such sequence is mutually stationary. What is the consistency strength of MS(⟨ω_n | n < ω⟩, ω_1), optionally together with the Continuum Hypothesis?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Work in ZFC. For an ordinal κ and a cardinal λ, write cof_λ = {ξ ∈ Ord : cf(ξ) = λ} and [κ]^λ = {X ⊆ κ : |X| = λ}. Recall that a set 𝒮 ⊆ [κ]^λ is stationary if for every function F : [κ]^{<ω} → κ there exists X ∈ 𝒮 with |X| = λ that is closed under F.

Let δ be an ordinal and let ⟨κ_α | α < δ⟩ be a strictly increasing sequence of uncountable regular cardinals with supremum κ. Fix a regular cardinal λ with λ < κ_0. For each α < δ let S_α ⊆ κ_α ∩ cof_λ be stationary in κ_α. The sequence ⟨S_α | α < δ⟩ is called mutually stationary if the set
   {X ∈ [κ]^λ : (∀α < δ) sup(X ∩ κ_α) ∈ S_α}
is stationary in [κ]^λ.

Let MS(⟨κ_α | α < δ⟩, λ) denote the statement: for every sequence ⟨S_α | α < δ⟩ as above, ⟨S_α⟩ is mutually stationary.

Determine the exact consistency strength (relative to large cardinal axioms) of the statement MS(⟨ω_n | n < ω⟩, ω_1), and likewise of MS(⟨ω_n | n < ω⟩, ω_1) together with the Continuum Hypothesis (2^{ω} = ω_1).
artifact.category_tag: mutual stationarity and inner model theory
artifact.status_search_result: The exact consistency strength of MS(⟨ω_n⟩_{n<ω}, ω_1) (with or without CH) appears to remain open. Recent work by Adolf–Ben-Neria, Adolf–Cox–Welch and others provides lower bounds (e.g., for variants with divergent cofinalities, with strength up to sharps for models with strong cardinals) and various consistency upper bounds, but no two-sided pinpoint of the strength of MS at ω_1-cofinality on ⟨ω_n⟩ has been published.

status_evidence.title: Lower consistency bounds for mutual stationarity with divergent cofinalities and limited covering
status_evidence.snippet: Improves previous results on the consistency strength of mutually stationary sequences of sets concentrating on points with divergent cofinalities.
status_evidence.claim: Recent partial lower-bound results, indicating that the exact strength is not yet determined.

status_evidence.title: On singular stationarity I (mutual stationarity and ideal-based methods)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies mutual stationarity on sequences of regular cardinals using ideal-based methods.
status_evidence.claim: Active research area; problem of exact consistency strength remains under investigation.

status_evidence.title: Consistency strength results about mutual stationarity (Koepke talk)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses consistency strength results for MS at various cardinal sequences.
status_evidence.claim: Talk surveys partial results but does not settle the strength of MS(⟨ω_n⟩, ω_1).
